metadata.question: Was nightime brightness around the Aswan High Dam higher than the Grand Ethopian Renaissance Dam in 2016?

data.exec_msg:
Dataset: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG, 2016 Images: 12
Aswan: valid=763/763 (100.0%), mean=6.833 nW/cm2/sr
GERD: valid=716/716 (100.0%), mean=2.283 nW/cm2/sr
Conclusion: Aswan>GERD = true
A
